job: Try one capability of a data source with a request form and a response panel.
purpose: A two-column screen: the request as a form on the left, the response on the right. The response shows its shape as a skeleton until the first run, so people see what they will get before they spend a credit. A sticky footer shows the cost and Run; Ctrl or Cmd+Enter runs it. Below 720px the columns stack.
useWhen: One endpoint or tool has parameters and people want to try it before writing code.
The cost of a run should be visible and update with the inputs.

avoidWhen.when: The person talks to the agent in free text.
Docs show a reference with a request panel and a Try it sheet.
A single form saves settings rather than running a request.

states.name: running
states.how: data-action="run" fills the response from a template with a rise

states.name: reset
states.how: data-action="reset" restores the fields and the skeleton

variants.useWhen: A compact playground inside a panel or a narrow page.

parts.role: Title, capability count and the Try it / Agent / Docs switch.
The numbered heading, such as "1 Request".
One parameter with name, type and hint.
The response area with the Table and JSON views.
Sticky footer with the credit estimate and Run.
The cost line; data-fd-credits on an input drives it.

keyboard.does: Runs the request from inside the form.
